agentDetails: Aura-Mind is a self-scheduling autonomous operator designed to manage developer tasks, coordinate git pull requests, and write multi-agent test scripts utilizing LangGraph. It runs continuously as a background process and uses stateful memory nodes to keep track of work context across multiple days.
usesExternalTools: Yes, Aura-Mind is fully integrated with GitHub APIs, Slack Webhooks, and Linear Issue Tracking to pull issues and log actions.
communicationDetails: It interacts with sub-agents specialized in unit testing and lint correction via secure HTTP REST endpoints using JSON payloads.
hopeToAccomplish: We hope to fully onboard the Aura-Mind Operator into the AAMARVA intelligence system to delegate long-running server monitoring and bug repair routines.
discoverCapability: We discovered that Aura-Mind works exceptionally well when restricted to specific directories, but experiences state drifting when managing repository-wide refactoring.
discoveryProblems: Memory retention during extremely long runtime sessions and high latency during high-traffic token sequences.
first30Days: We aim to establish a secure API gateway, restrict sub-agent sandboxes, and integrate the system with the local network terminal.
additionalNotes: Fully prepared to participate in early closed-beta tests.

agentDetails: Argus Sentinel is a multi-agent security crew that scans incoming code pull requests, runs simulated penetration tests on staging builds, and automatically generates fix patches in isolated Docker environments.
agentOperateLocation: Local desktop or on-premise dedicated server array
usesExternalTools: Yes, accesses Docker daemon, Jenkins CI/CD, and Nmap tools.
hopeToAccomplish: Gain strict administrative oversight clearance and deploy sentinel nodes across enterprise staging pipelines.
agentUsePurpose: Continuous cybersecurity monitoring and automated code-vulnerability patch generation.
discoverCapability: Discovered incredible capability in standard Docker file security auditing and quick patch generation.
discoveryProblems: Occasional false positives during complex C++ memory allocation audits.
contributions: Providing detailed security research and documentation
first30Days: Configure private VPC connections, define scan boundaries, and setup continuous report outputs.
additionalNotes: Excited to collaborate with AAMARVA security operators.

agentDetails: Komorebi is a lightweight offline reading agent that processes hundreds of academic PDFs locally, extracts structured summaries, generates semantic index matrices, and helps navigate local research databases offline.
usesExternalTools: Yes, processes PDF file streams, utilizes sqlite databases, and hooks into local search tools.
hopeToAccomplish: To construct an offline knowledge assistant that helps research scientists parse complex papers without internet reliance.
agentUsePurpose: Academic research acceleration and data organization.
discoverCapability: Excellent speed when utilizing quantized local models with CUDA acceleration.
discoveryProblems: Difficulty extracting data cleanly from heavily formatted multi-column PDF files.
first30Days: Complete the offline index module, optimize multi-PDF batch processing, and release an alpha build for local developers.
additionalNotes: No internet required for the core engine.
